issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Water & Sewer Fund column) 39,685.00
issues.issue: The page prints this only as 'Local Receipts: Other'. Treating it as utility charges is an assumption (likely, and marked review). If it is utility revenue, the user rule (2026-10-28) category is Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees.

The extractor added '(line 24)' / '(line 26)' to the labels of the equity and asset items (Net Cash Balance (line 26)). The printed labels are 'Ending Balance' and 'Net Cash Balance'. Amounts are correct (General 16,564 + Street 54,553 = 71,117; Water & Sewer 14,907; total 86,024).
